description: JSONPath query — Run a JSONPath query on JSON you pass (json=, URL-encoded) or fetch (url=, up to 2 MB). Supports $, .name, [quoted], [n], [-n], [a,b], [start:end:step], *, .. deep scan and [?(@.price<10 && @.inStock)] filters (== != < <= > >= && || !, @.x.length). Returns each match with its normalized path; values_only=true for a flat list, limit= up to 1000. Safe: no script evaluation. Price: $0.001 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: util_jsonpath
